```{r}
source("./pipe.R")
input = pipeline$bulk_mar25_H1975$input
output = pipeline$bulk_mar25_H1975$output
```


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(GSEABase))
source_from_github(repositoy = "DEG_functions",version = "0.2.54")
```

# Create data
```{r}
bulk_Mar25_raw = read.table(
  file = input$rna_counts,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
) %>% as.data.frame() 

bulk_Mar25_TPM = bulk_Mar25_raw %>%   dplyr::select(!c("Geneid","Chr", "Start", "End", "Strand","Length"))
rownames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = make.unique(bulk_Mar25_TPM[,"gene_name",drop=T])
bulk_Mar25_TPM  = bulk_Mar25_TPM %>% dplyr::select(!c("gene_name"))
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = gsub(pattern = ".bam",replacement = "",x = colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM))


```

```{r}
#adjust sample names
#read xlsx file
library(readxl)
sample_description = readxl::read_xlsx(input$sample_description, sheet = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() 

 sample_description = sample_description %>%  mutate(new_name = paste(sample_description$`Group Name\r\n(Required)`,c(1:3),sep = "_")) 


bulk_Mar25_TPM = bulk_Mar25_TPM[,sample_description$`Sample Name`]
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = sample_description$new_name
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM)  = colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) %>%  
  gsub(pattern = "_Osi_",replacement = "_osi_short_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_OsiRox_",replacement = "_osi_short_roxa_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_Per_",replacement = "_osi_persistor_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_PerRox_",replacement = "_osi_persist_roxa_") 


```


```{r}
# get cell line
cell_line_bulk = bulk_Mar25_TPM[,startsWith(colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM),params$cell_line)]
```

```{r}
# create metadata
cell.labels = names(cell_line_bulk)
condition = str_extract(cell.labels, "Veh|osi_short_[1-9]|Rox|osi_short_roxa|osi_persistor|osi_persist_roxa") %>% gsub(pattern = "_[1-9]",replacement = "")
peristor = str_extract(cell.labels, "short|persist")
metadata = data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(cell_line_bulk))
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(cell_line_bulk),
                              colData = metadata,
                              design = ~condition)
```
## PCA
```{r}
nrow(dds)
dds1 <- dds[ rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 3, ] # filter low count genes
nrow(dds1)
```

```{r}
vst = vst(dds1, blind=FALSE)
```
```{r}
library("ggfortify")
PCAdata <- prcomp(t(assay(vst)))
autoplot(PCAdata, data = metadata,colour = "condition",label = FALSE, main=paste(params$cell_line,"PCA")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = rainbow(6)) 


```


## DEG FC {.tabset}
```{r}
genesets = getGmt(input$genesets) %>% geneIds()


dds <- DESeq(dds)
cpVSop <- results(dds,contrast = c("condition","osi_persist_roxa","osi_persistor"),alpha = 0.5)  %>% as.data.frame()
roxaVSctrl <- results(dds,contrast = c("condition","Rox","Veh"),alpha = 0.5)  %>% as.data.frame()
diff_genes = data.frame(row.names = rownames(cpVSop), 
                        cpVSop_FC = cpVSop$log2FoldChange,
                        roxaVSctrl_FC = roxaVSctrl$log2FoldChange, 
                        cpVSop_padj = cpVSop$padj)
```

```{r}
# create 6 breaks between plot limits in log scale and then exponent, otherwise breaks not good
breaks_fun = function(limits){ 
  breaks = exp(-seq(-log(limits[1]), -log(limits[2]), length.out = 6))
  breaks[1] = breaks[1] * 0.95 #adjust extreme ticks to prevent truncation
  breaks[7] = breaks[7] * 1.05
  return(signif(breaks, digits = 2))
}

```



```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=13, results='asis'}
ranked_vec = cpVSop[,"log2FoldChange"]%>% setNames(rownames(cpVSop)) %>% na.omit() %>%  #order by FC
  sort(decreasing = T) # sort

# add senesence signatures to genesets
SASP_signature = c("CCL2", "CCL5", "CCL7", "IL1A", "IL1B", "IL32","SCG2", "INHBA", "INHA", "WNT7A", "CSF2", "TNFRSF11B", "GREM1", "CMTM3")
FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP  = getGmt(input$SENESCENCE) %>% geneIds() %>%  unlist() %>% base::unname()

genesets = c(genesets, list(SASP = SASP_signature,
                        FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP = FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP))


hyp_obj <- hypeR_fgsea(ranked_vec, genesets, up_only = F)
plt = hyp_dots(hyp_obj,merge = F)
plt1 = plt$up+ aes(size=nes)+ggtitle("up in comboPersistor")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =breaks_fun)
plt2 = plt$dn+ aes(size=abs(nes))+ggtitle("up in osiPersistors")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =breaks_fun)
print_tab(plt1+plt2,title = paste(params$cell_line,"cpVSop"))


ranked_vec = roxaVSctrl[,"log2FoldChange"]%>% setNames(rownames(roxaVSctrl)) %>% na.omit() %>% # make named vector
  sort(decreasing = T) # sort 

hyp_obj <- hypeR_fgsea(ranked_vec, genesets, up_only = F)
plt = hyp_dots(hyp_obj,merge = F)
plt1 = plt$up+ aes(size=nes)+ggtitle("up in roxa")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =breaks_fun)
plt2 = plt$dn+ aes(size=abs(nes))+ggtitle("up in ctrl")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =breaks_fun)
print_tab(plt1+plt2,title = paste(params$cell_line,"roxaVSctrl"))
```

# Average score

```{r}

hif_scores = cell_line_bulk[genesets$HIF_targets,] %>% colMeans() %>% data.frame(row.names = names(.), hif_score =.)
hif_scores = merge(x = hif_scores,y = metadata,by = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("Row.names")
hif_scores
hif_scores$condition = factor(hif_scores$condition,levels = c("Veh","Rox","osi_short","osi_short_roxa","osi_persistor","osi_persist_roxa"))
```
```{r}
summary_df <- hif_scores %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Score = mean(hif_score),
    SD_Score = sd(hif_score),
    N = n(),
    SE_Score = SD_Score / sqrt(N) # שגיאת תקן של הממוצע
  )

print(summary_df)
```

```{r}
ggplot(hif_scores, aes(x = condition, y = hif_score)) +
  # Add bars for the means
  geom_bar(data = summary_df, aes(y = Mean_Score), stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add individual data points (jittered to prevent overlap)
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, color = "darkblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Optional: Add error bars (Standard Error of the Mean)
  geom_errorbar(data = summary_df, aes(y = Mean_Score, ymin = Mean_Score - SE_Score, ymax = Mean_Score + SE_Score),
                width = 0.1, color = "black") +
  # Add titles and customize appearance
  labs(
    title = paste0(params$cell_line,"- Comparison of Mean Scores"),
    x = "Condition",
    y = "HIF score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + # Minimalist theme
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) # Center the title
```

```{r fig.width=15}
down_in_combo = diff_genes %>% filter(cpVSop_FC < 1/fc_threshold & cpVSop_padj<0.05) %>% rownames()
up_in_roxa =  diff_genes %>% filter(roxaVSctrl_FC > fc_threshold & roxaVSctrl_padj<0.05) %>% rownames()

ggvenn::ggvenn(data = all_list)
```

```{r}
up_only_in_combo = up_in_combo[!up_in_combo %in% c(up_in_roxa)]
only_down_in_combo = down_in_combo[!down_in_combo %in% c(down_in_roxa)]
only_up_in_roxa = up_in_roxa[!up_in_roxa %in% c(up_in_combo)]
only_down_in_roxa = down_in_roxa[!down_in_roxa %in%  c(up_in_combo)]
H1975_uniqe_deg_list = list(up_only_in_combo = up_only_in_combo,only_down_in_combo = only_down_in_combo,only_up_in_roxa = only_up_in_roxa,only_down_in_roxa = only_down_in_roxa)
names(H1975_uniqe_deg_list) = c("up_only_in_combo","only_down_in_combo","only_up_in_roxa","only_down_in_roxa")


```

```{r}
all_fdr_df = data.frame(row.names = names(genesets))
for (i in 1:length(H1975_uniqe_deg_list)) {
  geneset = H1975_uniqe_deg_list[[i]]
  if (length(geneset)>=3) {
    hyp_obj <- hypeR(geneset, genesets, test = "hypergeometric", fdr=1, plotting=F,
               background = rownames(bulk_Mar25_TPM))
    
    all_fdr_df[[names(H1975_uniqe_deg_list)[i]]] = -log10(hyp_obj$data[names(genesets),"fdr"])
    plt = hyp_dots(hyp_obj,title = paste(names(H1975_uniqe_deg_list)[i] ," - ",params$cell_line))
    plt = plt+
      scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =exp(-seq(-log(min(plt$data$fdr)), -log(max(plt$data$fdr)), 
            length.out = 6)) %>% signif(digits = 2))
    print(plt)
  }
}

all_fdr_df =all_fdr_df[,c("up_only_in_combo", "only_up_in_roxa", "only_down_in_combo", "only_down_in_roxa")]
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
threshold <- -log10(0.05)  

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, threshold - 0.01, threshold, max(all_fdr_df, na.rm=TRUE)),
  c("grey80", "grey80", "white", "red")
)

lgd <- Legend(
  title = "-log10(FDR)",
  col_fun = col_fun,
  direction = "vertical"
)

# ציור heatmap בלי legend
ht <- Heatmap(all_fdr_df,col = col_fun, row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),cluster_columns = F, show_heatmap_legend = FALSE, column_title= params$cell_line)

draw(ht, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 50), "mm"))
pushViewport(viewport(x=0.8, y=0.7, width=unit(4, "cm"), height=unit(6, "cm"), just=c("left","center")))
draw(lgd)
popViewport()


```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=9}
library(scales)
library(ggdendro)
library(patchwork)


df = diff_genes[hif_targets,] %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>% na.omit()
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = c("condition", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(FC|padj)"
  )
df_long = df_long %>% mutate(group = case_when(
  gene %in% HCC_uniqe_deg_list$up_only_in_combo ~ "up_only_in_combo",
  gene %in% HCC_uniqe_deg_list$only_down_in_combo ~ "only_down_in_combo",
  gene %in% HCC_uniqe_deg_list$only_up_in_roxa ~ "only_up_in_roxa",
  gene %in% HCC_uniqe_deg_list$only_down_in_roxa ~ "only_down_in_roxa",
  .default = "non-unique"
))
fc_mat <- df[, c("cpVSop_FC", "roxaVSctrl_FC")]
rownames(fc_mat) <- df$gene
d <- dist(fc_mat)
hc <- hclust(d)
dend_data <- ggdendro::dendro_data(hc)

gene_order <- rownames(fc_mat)[hc$order]
df_long$gene <- factor(df_long$gene, levels = gene_order)

dend_plot <- ggplot(ggdendro::segment(dend_data)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = y, xend = yend, y = x, yend = xend)) +  # change axis
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(gene_order), labels = gene_order, expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  scale_x_reverse() +  
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 10, l = 10))

dot_plot = ggplot(df_long, aes(x = condition, y = gene)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = -log10(padj), color = FC)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-max(df_long$FC), max(df_long$FC))
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 6)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Dotplot: FC by Color, Significance by Size",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Gene",
    color = "FC",
    size = "-log10(FDR)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))+
    geom_tile(data = distinct(df_long[, c("gene", "group")]),
            aes(x = "group", fill = group),
            width = 0.1, height = 0.8) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("group", unique(df_long$condition)))

final_plot <- dend_plot + dot_plot + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 4))
final_plot
```

```{r}

library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)

barplot_for_conditions <- function(data, signature, name) {
  scores_df = data[signature,] %>% colMeans() %>% data.frame(row.names = names(.), score =.)
  scores_df = merge(x = scores_df,y = metadata,by = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("Row.names")
  scores_df
  scores_df$condition = factor(scores_df$condition,levels = 
                                 c("Veh","Rox","osi_short","osi_short_roxa","osi_persistor","osi_persist_roxa"))
  summary_df <- scores_df %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Mean_Score = mean(score),
      SD_Score = sd(score),
      N = n(),
      SE_Score = SD_Score / sqrt(N)
    )
  
  stat.test <- scores_df %>%
    t_test(score ~ condition) %>%
    add_significance()
  
  my_comparisons <- list( c("Veh", "Rox"), c("Rox","osi_short"), c("osi_short","osi_short_roxa"), c("osi_short_roxa","osi_persistor"), c("osi_persistor","osi_persist_roxa"))
  
  comparisons_df <- do.call(rbind, my_comparisons) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(c("group1", "group2"))
  
  stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  semi_join(comparisons_df, by = c("group1", "group2")) %>% 
    add_xy_position(step.increase = 0)
  
  p =  ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = condition, y = score)) +
  # Add bars for the means
  geom_bar(data = summary_df, aes(y = Mean_Score), stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add individual data points (jittered to prevent overlap)
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, color = "darkblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Optional: Add error bars (Standard Error of the Mean)
  geom_errorbar(data = summary_df, aes(y = Mean_Score, ymin = Mean_Score - SE_Score, ymax = Mean_Score + SE_Score),
  width = 0.1, color = "black") +
  # Add titles and customize appearance
  labs(
  title = paste0(params$cell_line,"- Comparison of Mean ",name," Scores"),
  x = "Condition",
  y = name
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + # Minimalist theme
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+  # Center the title
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.adj",bracket.shorten = 0.1)
  return(p)
}
```
